The rolling semester deck is the primary daily teaching deck. The two reusable lesson decks below are confirmed as created for this class and are ready to share publicly. Other transportation presentations are excluded until their source, ownership, and reuse permission are confirmed.

## TTS Semester Daily Deck

[TTS 2026/27 Semester 1 Daily Announcements and Open Slides](https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1ACEIMH-hXDAxidR1jJYGOnR99Dy7YSvZ6Kaij7zXq6Y/edit)

Each dated TTS class slide belongs in this single chronological deck and should link to the lesson decks, handouts, job sheets, and service records used that day.
